title: Mark Twain predicts his death with Halley's Comet

tellings.quote: the Great American novelist Mark Twain even predicted his own death born on November 30th 1835 just as Haley's Comet was passing by Earth he would often say to people that he expected to go out with the comet upon its return just as he predicted he died in 1910

plain: The novelist Mark Twain was born on November 30, 1835, just as Halley's Comet, which passes Earth about every 75 years, was going by, and he often said he expected to "go out with the comet" when it came back. According to Michels, he died in 1910, just as he predicted. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as an example of people seeming to sense the future.
